name: io.github.tonyyang0504/wecom-mcp
description: WeCom (企业微信) (messaging): me, send. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_WECOM_CORPID
environmentVariables.description: Enterprise ID (我的企业 > 企业信息), sent with corpsecret to GET https://qyapi.weixin.qq.com/cgi-bin/gettoken; the returned access_token (7200 s) travels as the access_token query parameter of every call.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_WECOM_CORPSECRET
environmentVariables.description: Secret of the self-built app (应用管理 > 应用 > Secret); each app has its own secret and token. Do not call gettoken frequently (rate-limited); the runtime caches the token.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_WECOM_AGENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: AgentId (integer) of the self-built app shown on its settings page; required by message/send and agent/get.
